title: Remember to have Claude 5.5 review your old workflow and skills.
author: CrusherEAGLE
selftext:
I just had it check things that I set up a couple of months ago and improved and iterated on it. Things are working \*so\* much smoother and more efficient.

This is the first model I'm seeing that doesn't make me want to pull my hair out after it completes a task. It actually, for the *most* part, doesn't fuck up and makes fewer mistakes than before.

Also, remember to audit your codebase every now and then, especially when a newer model comes out!

Edit: I meant Opus 5.5 in the title, although we'll probably get Fable 5.5 soon anyway. Either way the model's incredible and I can't change the title.
